requirements: Requires FTK Mod Framework 1.3.0 or later within 1.x.
Restart the game after installing or removing the mod.
Free DLC entries unlock. Paid DLC entries you do not own stay locked.
Published for Windows, macOS and Linux on the listed game build. Gameplay verified on macOS only; Windows and Linux gameplay and online co-op remain unverified.
contentChanges: Every Lore Store class, item, encounter, location and cosmetic you could buy is unlocked, including free DLC packs.
No Lore Store purchase is written. Removing the mod restores your real unlocks.
Lore points still accumulate and remain yours to spend after removal.
changelog: Initial release. The banner is promotional artwork, not a gameplay screenshot.
